title: Subgroup measures and profinite rigidity in free groups
author: Shrinit Singh
work: Subgroup measures and profinite rigidity in free groups
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's theorem (thm:universal) (source0.tex lines 301-313, source label thm:universal). The statement reads: theorem thm:universal Let F and P be finitely generated free groups and let K F be finitely generated. Then enumerate K is profinitely rigid in F if and only if it is profinitely rigid in F*P ; K is setwise profinitely rigid in F if and only if it is setwise p. The retained complete proof (lines 954-1009, 56 lines, which the article places away from the statement) is the article's own argument, retained line for line.
